resources.string: Add .iso or .cso files, or a whole folder.
Compatible: plays on a real PSP and PPSSPP (2 KB blocks)
Smallest: PPSSPP only, about 15% smaller (16 KB blocks)
Delete originals after a verified conversion
Each original file will be deleted after its converted copy is verified. This can\'t be undone.

SquishISO %1$s

Shrinks game disc images (ISO) into compressed CSO files that play in emulators and on custom-firmware handhelds, and turns CSOs back into ISOs.

• 100%% offline: no internet permission, no ads, no tracking, no accounts.
• Every file is verified bit-for-bit after converting.
• Compatible mode (2 KB blocks) works on real hardware and PPSSPP. Smallest mode (16 KB blocks) is for PPSSPP only.

Only convert games you own.
